mode: event-driven; no timed or mandatory teaching overlay

strings.objectiveSleeping: Find a battery and wake the little courier.
strings.objectiveAwake: Bring both robots to their marked exit pads.
strings.hintBattery: Walk to the battery. Press E to pick it up.
strings.hintSocket: Bring the battery to the socket. Press E to connect it.
strings.hintBoot: Echo is running its fixed boot check. Take the orange exit pad.

beats.picture: Dark scrapyard city; Patch orange, Echo white/cyan; title and Enter the city.
beats.input: Pointer or keyboard activation of Enter the city.

beats.picture: Full-viewport maintenance lift, both robots, Start the heist.
beats.input: Start the heist. Settings and Missions remain available.
beats.exit: L01 loads after assets are ready.

beats.trigger: L01 loaded, awake=false, Patch cargo empty
beats.picture: Patch at (1,1), battery at (3,1), socket (3,3), sleeping Echo (3,5).
beats.input: Two east moves, then E; adjacency interaction is also legal.
beats.exit: batteryA in Patch cargo. No teaching modal.

beats.trigger: Patch carries batteryA and Echo asleep
beats.picture: Battery visible in Patch hands; socket remains visible.
beats.input: Move to socket or face it from an adjacent cell; press E.

beats.picture: Echo travels east using its fixed boot self-check; Patch remains controlled by player.
beats.input: Patch reaches orange exit (8,6), Echo reaches cyan exit (8,5).
beats.audio: Chapter base continues; not a learning-success effect.
beats.exit: Both exit predicates and battery delivery are true.

beats.picture: Small success dialog: A good little heist. Next mission or Replay.
Patch west bay; Echo confined to a blue service lane.
beats.input: Latch lever, ready receiver console, approach dock.
beats.audio: door_open and terminal_accept on real events
beats.exit: Practice and Send Echo available only with both handoffs prepared.

beats.picture: One priority choice: Shiny things / The delivery.
beats.input: Practice runs actual learning; Send Echo deploys its current frozen policy.
beats.audio: learning_launch / learning_session_complete only, never every update
beats.exit: Player sees a real autonomous route; no forced successful outcome.

rules: Player controls Patch; Echo is autonomous except its explicitly fixed boot check.
No auto-advancing text, dialogue typing lock, compulsory quiz, or equation display.
R retries the room. Compatible cartridge learning persists.
The tutorial never changes a failed action into success.
Human comprehension and playtime targets remain untested.
